HandleOffYoshi.name: Yoshi: draw, wings, mouth and tongue state
summary: Per-frame Yoshi graphics and mouth logic. Handles the turn-around flip, draws head and body, sets up the dynamic tile DMA
source addresses ($0D8B-$0D97), draws the wings, then runs the tongue/mouth state machine (CODE_01F0A2).
Sub-routines in this section: $01EF18 draws head+body (two SubSprGfx2 calls) and picks the mouth tile (blink, open, swallow);
$01F0A2 runs the tongue state machine; $01F0D3 gives the reward for a swallowed item (berries, coin sound).
Key RAM (names inferred): [$1594,X] tongue state, [$151C,X] tongue length, [$160E,X] sprite index in mouth ($FF none),
[$18AC] hold-in-mouth timer, [$18AE] tongue wind-up timer, [$1564,X] swallow timer, [$1602,X] animation frame.

Ptrs01F0CB.name: Pointer table: Yoshi tongue states
summary: Indexed by [$1594,X]: 0 idle ($01F14B), 1 tongue extending ($01F314), 2 tongue retracting ($01F332), 3 spit recovery ($01F12E).
Also contains $01F0D3 (swallow reward: SFX, coin, berry counters) and $01F12E (state 3).

YoshiShellAbility.name: Table: ability from Yoshi and shell colors
summary: Indexed by (YoshiAbilityIndex[Yoshi color] << 2) | YoshiAbilityIndex[shell color]. Bit 1 = wings, bit 0 = stomp (ground pound).

YoshiAbilityIndex.name: Yoshi tongue and spit logic
summary: Starts with the 6-byte table YoshiAbilityIndex (palette >> 1 -> color group 0-3 for YoshiShellAbility).
$01F14B (state 0, idle): grants wings/stomp while a Koopa shell is held in the mouth, counts down the hold timer and
swallows when it ends, runs the tongue wind-up timer, and on a Y/X press either starts the tongue or spits out the item.
Spitting: item placed in front of Yoshi, status $0A (kicked) or $09 (carryable); red shells/Yoshi turn it into 3 fireballs.
$01F295: spawn one Yoshi fireball (extended sprite $11). $01F2DF: spit sound and optional sprite change.

s01F2D9.name: Table: Yoshi fireball speeds
summary: X speed ($28,$24,$24) then Y speed ($00,$F8,$08), indexed by fireball number 0-2.

s01F2DF.name: Spit sound and sprite change
summary: Plays the spit SFX; if the spat sprite's tweaker bit $40 is set, turns it into SpriteToSpawn[num] and reloads its tweaker tables.
Parameters: Y = spat sprite slot.

s01F2FF.name: Table: spit speeds and offsets
summary: $01F2FF: unreferenced here ($20,$E0). $01F301: item X speed ($30,$D0 kick; $10,$F0 gentle). $01F305/07: item X offset lo/hi from Yoshi (+$10 / -$10).

s01F309.name: Tongue start and tongue states 1-2
summary: $01F309: starts the tongue ([$14A3] = $12, SFX). $01F314: tongue extending, +3 per frame up to $20. $01F332: tongue retracting
after a short pause, -4 per frame; when fully back, decides if the caught sprite stays in the mouth or is swallowed.
Swallowed items: status 0, swallow timer $1B, special cases for Changing Item and (unreachable) Bubble; tweaker $167A bit 6 gives a power-up.

s01F3D9.name: Table: Yoshi frame after eating
summary: Indexed by [$18DC]: Yoshi animation frame $00 or $04.
